messages:
maria: Heads up — the PR that changed GH Actions for infra (#2347) seems to have broken Atlantis plans (timeouts) and ArgoCD didn't pick up k8s manifests. Anyone seen this?
ajay: :eyes: I saw an Atlantis plan error in logs, it gets stuck at initializing then times out.
kevin: Do we know if the GH Action switched to `pull_request_target`? that can change runner context and checkout ref.
maria: It does use `pull_request_target` for infra checks. snippet:```yaml
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: run atlantis plan
        run: curl -sS https://atlantis.company/plan | bash
```
ajay: That could be fine, but I saw network errors in the atlantis container: `failed to download module: TLS handshake timeout`. Might be egress/network.
kevin: Also we renamed the manifest output dir in the PR earlier. ArgoCD expects `deploy/argocd/out/` but PR writes to `deploy/out/`. If ArgoCD points to the old path it won't see new manifests.
zoe: Confirmed — ArgoCD app points to `deploy/argocd/out`. The CI change moved files.
maria: Ohhh. I forgot to update the ArgoCD app path in the PR. Sorry. Quick options: update ArgoCD app config OR revert the dir rename.
infra-bot: Atlantis status: plan queued=3, last_error="TLS handshake timeout", last_attempt=2026-03-17T11:05:23Z :warning:
deploy-bot: ArgoCD sync status: app="redwood-infra" last_sync=2026-03-17T10:40:12Z health=Degraded path=deploy/argocd/out
ajay: Suggested next steps:
1) revert directory rename or update ArgoCD app path
2) rerun Atlantis plan once network issue resolved; add retries/timeouts in the GH Action
kevin: Notes on GH actions: if you need secrets for certain steps, `pull_request_target` runs in the base ref and has access to secrets, but `checkout` can fetch the head ref — be careful. For running `atlantis` server-side plans, prefer triggering server-side rather than executing protected actions in PR scope.
maria: Proposed quick patch: use `pull_request` for lint steps and let Atlantis run terraform plans from server-side. Also update argocd app path in terraform `k8s/argocd_app.yaml` and then `argocd app sync` after manifests are in place.
zoe: I'll open a small PR to update ArgoCD path (infra PR #2352).
ajay: I'll add retries around the network call to atlantis and bump the GH Action timeout.
kevin: I'll audit `atlantis.yaml` to ensure `apply_requirements` still match expectations (we want plan to run even if apply requires approval).
zoe: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2352 changes ArgoCD path to `deploy/out` and updates README.
maria: :thumbsup: ajay — can you rerun the workflow after you add retries so we can confirm plan?
ajay: Rerun started: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/1234567890 (restarted plan job).
infra-bot: Atlantis report: plan succeeded (attempt 4) at 2026-03-17T11:52:00Z. No diffs.
deploy-bot: ArgoCD: app "redwood-infra" synced successfully at 2026-03-17T12:00:05Z after PR #2352 merged. :white_check_mark:
maria: Great. TL;DR: root cause = manifest dir rename (ArgoCD path mismatch) + transient network causing Atlantis retries. Action items: (zoe) ArgoCD path PR merged, (ajay) add retries + bump timeout in GH Actions, (kevin) verify atlantis.yaml apply requirements, (maria) follow up on GH Action `pull_request_target` semantics.
kevin: Also we should add a CI check that verifies the existence of the ArgoCD path after build so renames fail fast.
zoe: Adding that test to infra CI.
maria: Thanks all — I'll close this thread in 24h if no follow-ups.
